text: BMAD Sprint Board（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在 Session 右侧侧栏把 BMAD v7 项目整理成可浏览的工单看板。插件通过工作区文件读取配置、倡议、史诗和工单，并提供状态、史诗、工单与倡议四种视图；还会标出索引与磁盘文件不一致、未知状态以及已完成容器仍含未完成工单等差异。适合需要在 DSH 会话中查看 BMAD v7 进度的用户。使用前需要项目文件位于当前 Session 工作区；不需要额外 API 密钥。

BMAD Sprint Board (DSH web plugin): view BMAD v7 initiatives, epics, and ticket status in the Session sidebar. It offers four project views and highlights mismatches between ticket indexes and files. Project files must be available in the current Session workspace; no extra API key is needed.
想在 DSH 侧栏直接查看 BMAD v7 的倡议和工单进度。
帮我按状态整理每个史诗里的工单，并快速找到还没完成的工作。
Show me where BMAD v7 tickets and epics stand without leaving my DSH session.
BMAD Sprint Board 的功能「项目进度视图」：在侧栏的状态、史诗、工单和倡议视图间切换，查看工单状态分组、史诗进度以及当前活跃倡议。
BMAD Sprint Board 的功能「项目差异提示」：状态视图检查索引与磁盘工单、计划文件及状态是否吻合，并列出已结束史诗或倡议中仍未结束的工单。
dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 17 天；提交数 10；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · BMAD Sprint Board：A [DSH Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) plugin that reads a
[BMAD](https://github.com/bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD) **v7** project and shows it
in the Session sidebar: every initiative, what is being worked on, and what the
ticket store disagrees with the tickets on disk.

**Read-only.** It never writes to your ticket store. Every action it offers is a
string you copy.

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · BMAD Sprint Board：```
Requirements │ BMAD Sprint board │ Chat
-------------------------------------------
Status   Epic   Tickets   Initiatives

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · Four views, one tab：| View | Shows |
|---|---|
| **Status** | One foldable lane per ticket state, with a gaps board beneath it |
| **Epic** | One section per epic: its status, its tickets, and its progress |
| **Tickets** | Every ticket in the initiative, grouped by state, across all epics |
| **Initiatives** | Every initiative with its status and counts, marking the active one |

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · Four views, one tab：Selecting an initiative in **Initiatives** loads it into the other three views.
The selection is local: nothing is written back, so looking at another initiative
cannot change which one BMAD considers active.

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · BMAD v7 only：This is version 2. Version 1 read BMAD v6 -- `sprint-status.yaml`, `epics.md`,
`spec-*.md` -- and none of those exist in a v7 project. The two are different
data models, not different formatting, so the plugin is released in two versions:

| BMAD | Install |
|---|---|
| **v7** | `dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board` (this one, 2.x) |
| v6 | `dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board@1.0.0` |

Opened on a v6 project, 2.x says so and points at 1.0.0 rather than rendering an
empty board.

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · The gaps board：| Detector | Fires when |
|---|---|
| **L1** unreadable ticket files | a file in a ticket folder is neither a leaf ticket nor a plan, so the store ignores it |
| **L2** unlisted leaves | a leaf ticket exists on disk with no entry in the ticket index |
| **L3** plans no ticket claims | a plan file corresponds to no index entry |
| **L4** unrecognised status | a ticket carries a status word this board does not know |
| **C1** epic settled with open tickets | an epic says `done` while tickets inside it are not |
| **C2** initiative settled with open tickets | an initiative says `done` while tickets inside it are not |
| **E1** initiative declares no epics | the folder exists and its store lists no epics |

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · The gaps board：**L1 is the one that matters on a migrated project.** The ticket store decides
what a file is from its frontmatter `type`: `story`, `spike` or `bug` is a leaf
that carries the ticket, anything else declaring a `ticket` key is a plan over
one, and anything else is ignored. A file named `story-x-plan.md` whose type is
`feature` and which names no ticket is therefore *neither* — invisible to the
tooling, which reports its ticket as backlog however finished the work is. Every
number it prints is wrong while every file on disk looks correct.

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · The gaps board：**The board's lanes are the store's lanes.** States come from `tickets.py`'s own
table rather than being invented: an empty status is **backlog**, because a planned
story looks exactly like that before `bmad-build` writes its plan — a plan is an
artefact of building, not a precondition of existing. Only a status word the store
does not define becomes *unknown*, and it is shown but never counted as settled.

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · How it reads a v7 project：It resolves the same two keys the official tooling does, by merging the same
three files lowest priority first:

```
_bmad/config.toml                 [core] output_folder
_bmad/custom/config.toml          team overrides
_bmad/custom/config.user.toml     [core] active_initiative
```

which is what `_bmad/scripts/resolve_config.py` does. The board agrees with that
script rather than assuming a layout.
section: How it reads a v7 project

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · Install：From npm, into the `web` profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board
```

Or from the repository, and from a local clone:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:vitaliy-bobrov/dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/bmad-sprint-board-bundle
```

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · Install：Substitute your own profile name for `web`. Nothing needs building, the package
has no dependencies, and it runs no install scripts. Reload the page afterwards:
the Client half registers on the next load, and the Host half contributes nothing
to register.

The same three, through the agent's tool rather than the CLI:

```
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle",
                 target: "dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board" })
```

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · Peer dependency：The manifest declares one peer, and the range is not the obvious one:

```json
"peerDependencies": { "@deepseek-ai/dsh": "^0.2.0-0" }
```

A plain `^0.2.0` is **rejected**. The compatibility check compares the range
against the running version with prereleases included, and against a runtime such
as `0.2.0-rc.2` a bare `^0.2.0` does not match — so the install is refused before
pnpm runs. `^0.2.0-0` resolves to `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0`: prereleases of 0.2.0,
every later 0.2.x, and nothing beyond.

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · Category：**UI & Experience.** It adds a sidebar tab and reads. It contributes no tool, no
model and no service, and it writes nothing.

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · Extending：The plugin is two layers, and only the second knows about DSH:

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Parsers | `src/toml.js`, `src/frontmatter.js` — the two readers BMAD's files need |
| The project model | `src/config.js`, `src/store.js`, `src/model.js`, `src/scan.js` — pure, no DSH, no DOM |
| The checks | `src/detect.js` |
| How it renders | `src/shell-*.js` — CSS, components, slot registration |

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · Extending：Adding a **view** is one entry in the view list in `src/shell-post.js` plus a body
function; the switcher, the fold state and the snapshot are already shared.

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · Extending：Adding a **detector** is a function returning gaps shaped
`{ id, title, severity, subject, evidence, action }` and one push in
`detectInitiative()`. `src/model.test.js` shows the shape: each detector is
tested against a fixture that should fire it *and* a clean fixture beside it,
because a detector nobody has checked can stay quiet is one nobody has checked.

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · Extending：```bash
node build.mjs          # reassemble client.js from src/
node build.mjs --check  # fail if client.js and src/ have drifted apart
node --test src/*.test.js
```

`client.js` is committed on purpose: an install from a registry or a git URL does
no build, so the assembled bundle has to be present. Edit `src/`, rebuild, and
`--check` will tell you if you forget.

dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · More：- [Implementation notes](https://github.com/vitaliy-bobrov/dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board/blob/main/docs/implementation.md)
  — the parsing, the linking rules and the bundle layout. None of it is needed to
  install or use the plugin.
dsh-plugin-bmad-sprint-board README · Licence：MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
